relationships.subject: 7-Hydroxyflavone
relationships.evidence_quote: it attenuated the nociceptive pain, carrageenan-induced paw edema, and the development of mechanical and cold allodynia, and hyperalgesia dose-dependently without causing motor coordination deficit

key_findings: 7-Hydroxyflavone inhibited COX-2 and 5-LOX in vitro and attenuated paclitaxel/vincristine-induced mechanical and cold allodynia and hyperalgesia in rats.
7HF reduced vincristine-induced spinal expression of COX-2, TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β and NF-κB.
